addendum: Wikipedia-led tests, addendum h: Test F on concept pages only (the AI's own page-kind label)
parent_record: prereg/addenda_wiki_led/2026-10-21_g_ai_matchmaking.json (Test F); all its settings apply unless changed here
fixed_by: Claude, for Khant Phyo Wai, who asked at 20:45 on 21 Oct to run the concept-pages-only test proposed after the Test F results
question: Does the matchmaking effect of Test F come close to the hand-checked concept pages of Chapter 6 (about 9 to 11% more borrowing in months 0 to 2 after lasting rises) when the AI's attention series uses only the pages the AI itself labelled as concepts?
series_S2C: Pages of the Test F universe whose AI page kind (step 20, assign_pages.parquet, column kind) is 'concept' and that have at least one theme of confidence 2 or 3: 6,241 pages, 9,541 page-theme pairs of confidence 2 or 3. Full daily user views (Wikimedia REST, all-access, user agent, 2015-07-01 to 2026-09-30, at most 3 requests a second) for every such page, no cap; the pages not yet in the Test F view store (1,606) are downloaded first. Weights, narrow and middle themes, weekly sums and the monthly rule exactly as S2. Monthly column aic2_wlog.

tests.H1_matchmaking_primary: G2 of addendum g with S2C in place of S2: the same detector and settings (1.5 times the normal level of the previous 26 weeks for 4 weeks or more), the same quality flags (one-day, desktop-only, from 22 --desktop S2C), the same donor and placebo screen (rises of the new series, here S2C, plus the stored GDELT rises), 2,000 bootstrap resamples clustered by theme, panels a, b and c. Decision: panel a, both levels pooled, synthetic control, months 0 to 2, rises of 4 weeks or more: 95% interval above 0.
tests.H1_comparison_with_chapter6: Descriptive, fixed now: the S2C estimate is called close to the hand-checked level if the 95% interval of the panel a, both levels pooled, synthetic-control estimate contains 0.088 (the smaller of the two Chapter 6 per-level estimates, narrow 0.088 and middle 0.105). Per-level rows are reported beside the Chapter 6 rows and the S2 rows of Test F.
tests.H1_secondary: Panels b and c and the paired b minus c; rises of 1 or 2 weeks; the run with flagged rises included; own-trend estimates. Descriptive.
tests.H2_forecasting_secondary: On the benchmark's main rows (36,081 forecasts): Chronos-2 with aic2_wlog as the covariate (chronos2_aic2) against Chronos-2 alone, against the concept-page covariate of the benchmark (chronos2_cur) and against chronos2_ais2, paired ratios of MAE with the category bootstrap; and the Wikipedia-only ranking of S2C (the Test C measure). Descriptive; no decision.

time_rules: None beyond addendum g. Nothing is rerun after a result is seen except to fix a coding error, which is logged in prereg/DEVIATIONS.md.
seen_before_fixing: All Test F results (data/reports/testF_results.md, 21 Oct 20:31): G2 on S2 +1.8% [0.05%, 3.5%] (synthetic control, both levels pooled), own trend about 0; panel b +3.8%; Chapter 6 concept pages 9 to 11%; G3 -0.21% for S2 and -0.62% for the concept-page covariate; page kind counts (concept 6,384 universe pages, 6,241 with a theme of confidence 2 or 3, 4,635 of them already in the view store). No S2C series, rise or result exists.
